p: balance is abomination to the LORD: Under this word he condemns all false weights, measures and deceit.
shame: When man so gets himself, and thinks to be exalted above his calling then God brings him to confusion.
stead: That is, will enter into trouble.
hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his: A deceiver who pretends friendship, but privately is an enemy.
rejoiceth: The country is blessed, where there are godly men, and they ought to rejoice when the wicked are taken away.
holdeth his peace: Will not make light report of others.
counsellors there is safety: Where God gives store of men of wisdom and counsel.
stranger shall smart for it: He who does not without judgment and consideration of the circumstances put himself in danger, as in Pr 6:1.
that hateth suretiship is secure: He who does not co-sign loans for others is very wise.
doeth good to his own soul: Rewards both himself and others.
Though hand join in hand: Though they make many friends, or think themselves sure, yet they will not escape.
is wrath: They can look for nothing but God's vengeance.
and yet increaseth: Meaning they who give liberally, whom God blesses.
than is right: That is, the miser.
selleth it: That provides for the use of them who are in need.
house shall inherit the wind: The covetous men who spare their riches to the hinderance of their families, will be deprived of it miserably.
servant to the wise of heart: For though the wicked are rich, yet they are only slaves to the godly, who are the true possessors of the gifts of God.
winneth souls is wise: That is, brings them to the knowledge of God.
recompensed upon the earth: Will be punished as he deserves, 1Pe 4:18.
